verdict.rationale: Poke's docs say it supports Model Context Protocol servers to extend it with custom tools and data sources. Users can connect any MCP-compatible server directly, either with `npx poke@latest mcp add <url>` or by tunneling a local server, and Poke then uses those tools to perform actions through conversation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that third-party MCP tools work reliably in practice.
